summary: Simple unconditional two-field setter. Writes a2 to this[2] (this+0x8) and a3 to this[3] (this+0xC). Returns a2. No guards. Consistent with existing analysis labeling it a position/offset pair setter.

operations.description: this[2] (this+0x8) = a2; unconditional write of the first parameter.
this[3] (this+0xC) = a3; unconditional write of the second parameter.
Return a2 (the first parameter), retained as the function result.

unresolved: The semantic role of the two written fields (this+0x8, this+0xC) is unknown; existing analysis tentatively calls them position/offset values but this is not independently confirmed.
